title: Booking a Study Room
context: Maya 下午要和同学做小组作业，到图书馆前台预约研讨室；工作人员 Jordan 帮她确认人数、使用时长和房间设施，并说明迟到保留与取消规则。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Hi, I'd like to reserve a study room for this afternoon, please.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想预约一间今天下午的研讨室。

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Sure. How many people will be using it, and for how long?
dialogue.zh: 好的。你们几个人用，需要用多久？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: There will be four of us, and we need it for two hours.
dialogue.zh: 我们有四个人，需要用两个小时。

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: I have a room on the third floor from 2:00 to 4:00. Does that work for you?
dialogue.zh: 三楼有一间，下午两点到四点。这个时间可以吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: That works. Do I need a library card to book it?
dialogue.zh: 可以。预约需要借书证吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Yes, I'll need to see your library card. The room holds up to six people, so you'll have some extra space.
dialogue.zh: 需要，请出示一下你的借书证。这间最多可以坐六个人，所以你们还会有一点空余位置。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Perfect. Can we use the whiteboard and the screen in the room?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。房间里的白板和屏幕我们可以用吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Yes. There are markers in the drawer, and you can plug your laptop into the screen.
dialogue.zh: 可以。白板笔在抽屉里，你也可以把笔记本电脑接到屏幕上。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Great. What if we're a few minutes late?
dialogue.zh: 好的。如果我们晚到几分钟怎么办？

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: We hold the room for ten minutes. After that, we may give it to someone else.
dialogue.zh: 房间会为你们保留十分钟。超过这个时间，我们可能会把房间给其他人。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Got it. Can I cancel if our plans change?
dialogue.zh: 明白了。如果我们计划有变，可以取消吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Yes, please cancel online or at the desk at least an hour ahead. You're all set. Here's your confirmation.
dialogue.zh: 可以，请至少提前一小时在网上或到前台取消。都办好了。这是你的确认单。

expressions.en: I'd like to reserve a study room
expressions.zh: 我想预约一间研讨室，在图书馆前台说明需求时常用。
expressions.example: Hi, I'd like to reserve a study room for this afternoon, please.

expressions.zh: 这个安排可以吗？用来确认时间或方案是否合适。
expressions.example: I have a room on the third floor from 2:00 to 4:00. Does that work for you?

expressions.en: We hold the room for ten minutes
expressions.zh: 房间会先为你保留十分钟，说明迟到宽限时常用。
expressions.example: We hold the room for ten minutes. After that, we may give it to someone else.

expressions.zh: 至少提前一小时，取消或改期时常用。
expressions.example: Please cancel online or at the desk at least an hour ahead.

expressions.zh: 都办好了，表示事情已经安排妥当。
expressions.example: You're all set. Here's your confirmation.

pronunciation: reserve 的重音在第二音节，读作 /rɪˈzɜːrv/；third 的 th 读作 /θ/，floor 读作 /flɔːr/；whiteboard 读作 /ˈwaɪtbɔːrd/；confirmation 的重音在第三音节，读作 /ˌkɑːnfərˈmeɪʃn/；cancel 的重音在第一音节，读作 /ˈkænsl/。

practice.title: Part 1 · Libraries
practice.prompt: Do you often study in a library?
practice.answer: Yes, I do. I usually go to the library a few times a week when I have group work or need a quiet place. I sometimes book a study room so my classmates and I can talk without bothering other people.

practice.title: Part 2 · Booking a study room
practice.prompt: Describe an imagined time you booked a study room at a library. Say why you needed it, how you reserved it, and what the staff told you about the room.
practice.answer: Imagine that I am at the library desk to reserve a study room for four classmates. I ask for a two-hour booking in the afternoon, and the staff offers a room on the third floor from 2:00 to 4:00. I show my library card, and I also ask if we can use the whiteboard and the screen. The staff tells me they will hold the room for ten minutes if we are late, and I should cancel at least an hour ahead if our plans change. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Study spaces
practice.prompt: Why do some people prefer studying in a library instead of at home?
practice.answer: A library is usually quieter than home, and it can be easier to focus when other people are studying too. Some libraries also have study rooms, screens, and a stable internet connection, which are useful for group work. At home it is more comfortable, but it is easier to get distracted.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读，再完成口头练习。
practice.answer: 用四到六句在图书馆前台预约一间今天下午的研讨室：说明人数和时长，询问能否使用白板和屏幕，并问迟到或取消需要注意什么。
